His LinkedIn profile independently carries the headline 'Consultant Medical Oncologist at AIG', which corroborates both employer and role.

BAND IS MEDIUM, NOT HIGH: only ONE independent official source exists (aighospitals.com). LinkedIn and the drjanarthanbabus.getmy.clinic microsite are self-published and, per the banding rule, cannot be the second source. Skedoc, Sehat and SecondMedic are corroborating directories only. A targeted healinindia.gov.in query returned NO government profile for him, so nothing lifted the row to High.

NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED. No AIG-published per-doctor email or telephone number surfaced anywhere in search. A JustDial listing (Dr Janarthan Babu S, Asian Institute Of Gastroenterology, Somajiguda) appeared in results and its number was REJECTED OUTRIGHT as a JustDial call-tracking proxy, per the rules. Nothing was inferred from the aighospitals.com domain - no address was constructed.

NAME-SPELLING CAUTION FOR HUMAN REVIEW: a Credihealth listing for 'Dr. Janardhan Babu - Oncologist in Hyderabad' (https://www.credihealth.com/doctor/janardhan-babu-oncologist) uses a DIFFERENT spelling ('Janardhan' vs 'Janarthan') and was deliberately NOT recorded, because it could not be confirmed as the same person. The JustDial listing places him at the AIG Somajiguda unit while AIG's own page places him at Banjara Hills; AIG runs multiple Hyderabad units, so this is consistent rather than contradictory, but only the AIG-stated campus is recorded.
